Théâtre D'opéra Spatial ( pronounced [teɑtʁ dɔpeʁa spasjal] ; French for 'Space Opera Theater') is a digital arts piece generated and edited by an American man named Jason M. Allen with the generative artificial intelligence (GAI) model Midjourney . It won the 2022 Colorado State Fair 's annual fine art competition in the "emerging artist" (non-professional) division of the "Digital Arts/Digitally-Manipulated Photography" category [ a ] on August 29, becoming one of the first images made using GAI to win such a prize. [ 1 ] [ 3 ] [ 4 ] [ 5 ] The award came with a $300 cash prize. [ 1 ]
